rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a clash or incompatibility, especially between opposing people or groups.

example.english: These two departments are constantly in conflict over resource allocation.
example.traditional: 呢兩個部門成日為咗資源分配發生衝突。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 seng4 jat6 wai6 zo2 zi1 jyun4 fan1 pui3 faat3 saang1 cung1 dat6

rows.note: Use this for a schedule or appointment conflict when two events are set for the same time.

example.english: There’s a conflict between my meeting with the client tomorrow morning and our department’s briefing.
example.traditional: 我聽日朝早同客戶開會，但係同部門個簡報會撞期喎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 tung4 haak3 wu6 hoi1 wui2 daan6 hai6 tung4 bou6 mun4 go3 gaan2 bou3 wui2 zong6 kei4 wo3
